title: Document how to extend the autonomy backlog
summary: When the autonomy task queue is empty and `autonomy-seed-next` reports backlog exhaustion, operators need a clear, validated path to add the next alpha-critical task template. Document the rules and tighten the failure message so the loop doesn't stall.
expectedFailureModes: Autonomy sessions stall because there is no documented way to add the next backlog template safely.
New backlog entries break validation because required fields or workflow enums are missing.
Contributors add task templates that include local-only identifiers or unvalidated commands, making the public record brittle.
nextAction: Document how to add a new task template to agent-os/autonomy/backlog.json (fields, enums, verification), and update the backlog exhaustion error to point at that process.
